A NOTE FROM THE FOUNDER

“The first conversation is about understanding your whole picture.”

I founded DWP Consulting to help physicians and accomplished families connect the financial conversations that too often happen separately. You should not have to carry every message between your wealth manager, CPA, attorney, and other specialists.

Our first call is a chance to hear what you have built, what feels disconnected, and what you want your wealth to make possible. There is no pressure and no obligation—just a focused conversation about whether we can help.

Gary Kauffman Founder, DWP Consulting
